workflow.assignee_help: Group or role name, or user name (name or name@provider).
workflow.cancel_confirm: Cancel this case? It is closed and stays in the history.
workflow.description_help: Shown above the form. Blank lines separate paragraphs.
workflow.err_action: Step "{step}": every action needs a button text and a next step.
workflow.err_field_label: Every form field needs a label.
workflow.err_steps: A workflow needs at least one step.
workflow.fields_help: Fields the person fills in when starting a case (e.g. an application form).
workflow.final_help: End state: the case is closed when it reaches this step.
workflow.label: Label
workflow.login: Sign in to start a case
workflow.start_help: After submitting, the case goes to the first step: {step}.
workflow.started_none: You have not started any cases.
workflow.steps_help: The case starts in the first step. Each action leads to a next step; steps without actions end the case.
workflow.template_confirm: Replace the current process with the template?
workflow.approval_help: The case continues when enough people have approved. A single rejection ends the approval.
workflow.condition_help: Checks the details of the start form automatically and continues accordingly (e.g. different interviewers per position).
workflow.delay_help: Waits a fixed time or until a date from the form (e.g. the start date) and then continues automatically.
workflow.due_days_help: Reminds the people responsible by e-mail if nothing happened. 0 = no reminder.
workflow.email_help: Sends an e-mail automatically and continues. All fields may contain placeholders such as {{field.email}} or {{actor.name}}.
workflow.email_to_help: Addresses, {{field.email}}, starter, actor, user:name, group:name or role:name, separated by commas.
workflow.email_from_help: Optional. Only addresses allowed by the administrator are used as sender, others as reply-to address.
workflow.err_email: Step "{step}": recipient, subject and text are required.
workflow.err_rules: Step "{step}": every rule needs a field.
workflow.mail_not_configured: No mail server is configured yet; e-mails are kept until an administrator sets one up.
workflow.next_error_help: Optional; without it, the case waits for a manager to retry or skip.
workflow.placeholders_help: Click a placeholder to insert it into the last field you were in.
workflow.required_approvals_help: 0 = everyone in the group or role
workflow.webhook_help: Sends the case as JSON to another system (e.g. HR software) and continues when it answers with success. Three attempts.
workflow.webhook_no_allow: Webhooks only work for addresses an administrator allowed in config.yaml (plugins.macros.http_allow).
workflow.webhook_secret_help: Signs the request: header X-Ewiki-Signature: sha256=… The secret is stored outside of the workflow and never shown again.
workflow.template.onboarding: Onboarding (with waiting time and welcome e-mail)
perm.workflow.process.create_help: Create workflows and change or delete your own ones (with their steps and assignees).
perm.workflow.process.admin_help: Change and delete all workflows of the category. Every change is logged in detail and the creator is notified.
perm.workflow.process.cases_help: See all cases of the workflows, cancel them and decide about failed steps. Who carries out a step is defined only by its assignee.
limit.workflow.process.trigger_per_hour: Starts of a trigger per hour
How many cases one trigger of a workflow (schedule, change, event, incoming webhook) may start in an hour; further starts are skipped and shown in the editor.
workflow.kind.inbox: Messages of workflows (in the wiki only)
workflow.channel.both: In the wiki and by e-mail (as each person chose)
workflow.run_as.definer: the person who saved the workflow
workflow.run_as.starter: the person who started the case
workflow.notice_on.enter: when the case reaches the step
workflow.notice_on.leave: when the case leaves the step
workflow.trigger_event.workflow.complete: a case of another workflow ended
workflow.trigger_event.workflow.cancelle: a case of another workflow was cancelled
workflow.trigger_run_as.definer: the person who saved the workflow
workflow.trigger_run_as.actor: the person who caused the event
workflow.create_body_help: Placeholders are replaced by the values of the case.
workflow.create_help: Creates a page with the rights of the person chosen below.
workflow.create_store_help: Name of a value of the case that receives the id of the page (e.g. for “Set properties”).
workflow.deadline_warn_help: Several values separated by commas, e.g. 48, 4. The assignees receive an e-mail each time.
workflow.deadline_workdays_help: Weekends and the holidays of the setting “holidays” (Administration → Workflow) do not count.
workflow.err_create: Step “{step}”: category and title of the new page are required.
workflow.err_notify: Step “{step}”: recipients and subject are required.
workflow.err_props: Step “{step}”: page and at least one property are required.
workflow.err_set: Step “{step}”: every value needs a name.
workflow.err_subflow: Step “{step}”: choose the workflow to start.
workflow.escalate_extra_help: Optionally also a message (leave the recipients empty for none).
workflow.escalate_help: Happens once when the deadline passed and the step is still open.
workflow.escalate_notify_help: Who is told that the deadline passed:
workflow.hook_has_secret: A secret exists. It is never shown again; create a new one if it was lost.
workflow.hook_new_secret: Create a new secret (the old one stops working)
workflow.hook_no_secret: There is no secret yet: the address accepts nothing.
workflow.hook_save_first: Save the workflow to get the address and the secret.
workflow.hook_secret_once: Copy it now: it is shown only this once and is not part of the workflow.
workflow.hook_sign_help: The other system sends POST with JSON and the headers X-Ewiki-Timestamp (Unix time) and X-Ewiki-Signature: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body) in hex; optionally X-Ewiki-Delivery (an id: every delivery starts once). Requests older than 5 minutes are refused.
workflow.http_help: Queries another system (only addresses of the allow list) and takes values of the JSON answer into the case.
workflow.http_map_help: Path in the answer, e.g. data.status or items.0.id; empty: the whole answer as text.
workflow.http_url_help: Placeholders only in path and query (they are URL-encoded).
workflow.no_manual: Start only by triggers (no start form)
workflow.no_manual_help: Forms and other workflows can still start cases.
workflow.notices_help: Messages when a case reaches or leaves this step (besides the usual task e-mails).
workflow.notify_help: Sends a message in the wiki and/or by e-mail and continues at once.
workflow.notify_to_help: starter, actor, assignees, user:NAME, group:NAME, role:NAME or e-mail addresses (only for e-mails), separated by commas.
workflow.props_element_help: Id or address of the page, e.g. {{field.page}} from “Create a page”.
workflow.props_help: Sets properties of a page with the rights of the person chosen below.
workflow.run_as_help: Never with the rights of an administrator who only changed the workflow: the person who saved the version of the case counts.
workflow.set_field_help: A field of the start form or a new name (a-z, 0-9, _): later steps use it as {{field.NAME}}.
workflow.set_formula_help: With numbers of the case: + - * / %, round(x, 2), min, max, abs, if(a > b, 1, 0); dates count as days.
workflow.set_help: Sets or computes values of the case and continues at once.
workflow.subflow_help: Starts a case of another workflow with the rights of the person chosen below.
workflow.subflow_next_failed: Step if the other case failed or was cancelled
workflow.subflow_wait: Wait until the other case ended
workflow.subflow_wait_help: Without waiting this case continues at once.
workflow.trigger_inactive: Not active (switched off or not saved yet)
workflow.trigger_allow_from_help: Addresses, networks (192.0.2.0/24) or host names, one per line. Empty: every sender with the secret.
workflow.trigger_cron_help: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 7 * * 1-5 (working days at 7:00) or @daily, @weekly, @monthly.
workflow.trigger_definer_help: Starts with the rights of the person who saved the workflow.
workflow.trigger_prop_help: Optional: start only when a property takes a value (e.g. status equals review) – once per change.
workflow.trigger_run_as_help: The person must see the workflow and the page or event; otherwise nothing starts.
workflow.trigger_sources_help: Only pages the chosen person can see count.
workflow.triggers_help: Cases start with the start form on the page and – automatically – by triggers. Each start is recorded; starts per hour are limited.
workflow.admin.title: Workflow
workflow.admin.intro: Settings of all workflows. Triggers, steps and deadlines are set in each workflow.
workflow.admin.holidays_help: Days that do not count for deadlines in working days: yearly days (12-25) or dates (2027-03-29), one per line.
workflow.webhook_secret_kept: A secret is stored – leave empty to keep it
workflow.field_later: Filled in later (not in the start form)
workflow.field_later_help: The assignees of a step fill it in (form of the step).
workflow.step_form_help: What the assignees of this step fill in or may not see. The person who started the case, managers and administrators always see everything.
workflow.step_form_none: Add fields to the workflow first.
workflow.parallel_help: Runs branches at the same time; each branch ends when it reaches the meeting point. Then the case continues there.
workflow.parallel_for_each_help: Or one branch per value of a field (one value per line or comma), e.g. one approval per department; the value is {{field.item}}.
workflow.parallel_require_help: 0 = all. With fewer, the other branches are cancelled as soon as enough ended.
workflow.parallel_join_help: A branch ends when it reaches this step; the case continues there.
workflow.parallel_failed: Step if not enough branches succeed
workflow.err_parallel: Step “{step}”: choose the branches and the meeting point.
workflow.handover.claim_help: You take over the task: the others of the group no longer see it until you give it back.
workflow.handover.release_help: The task goes back to the group or role.
workflow.handover.delegate_help: Another person takes over the task (they must see the workflow).
workflow.handover.ask_help: The person who started the case answers first; then the task comes back to you.
workflow.handover.answer_help: Your answer goes back to the person who asked.
workflow.handover.to_help: User name (name, or name@provider for other sign-ins).
workflow.handover.to_missing: Enter the person who takes over.
workflow.handover.state_claim: Taken over by one person of the group.
workflow.handover.state_ask: Waiting for an answer of the requester.
workflow.deputy.title: Deputy
workflow.deputy.help: While you are away your deputy handles your tasks (also of your groups and roles) and receives your task e-mails. Everything stays recorded with their name.
workflow.deputy.planned: {name} will stand in for you from {from} to {until}.
workflow.mail.links: Decide directly (each link works once, until {until}):
workflow.test_help: A test run goes through the process with sample data: all tasks come to you, nothing leaves the wiki (no e-mails, messages, webhooks or pages) and the run is deleted after 7 days.
workflow.stats.title: Evaluation
workflow.link.title: Decision from an e-mail
workflow.link.invalid: The link is incomplete. Please open it again from the e-mail.
workflow.link.what: “{action}” in the step “{step}” of the case “{title}”.
workflow.link.login: Sign in and decide in the case
workflow.link.other_user: This link was sent to another person. Please sign in with the account it was sent to.
workflow.link.without_login_help: You can confirm the decision here without signing in.
workflow.link.done: Done: “{action}” for “{title}”. You can close this page.
workflow.admin.links: Decisions from e-mails without signing in
workflow.admin.links_help: Workflows with decision links in their e-mails may then be decided without signing in. Each link works once, for one person and one step, and never for confidential or secret categories.
workflow.links_help: Task e-mails contain one link per decision. Opening it leads to the case; without signing in only when the administrator allows it.
workflow.retention.help: Empty: keep forever. After this time completed and cancelled cases are anonymized or deleted.
workflow.retention.anonymize: anonymize (title, data, notes and persons removed)
workflow.links_valid_help: At most 90 days. A link never stays valid past the deadline of its step and ends as soon as the case moves on.
workflow.trigger_event.group.member_adde: someone was added to a group
workflow.trigger_event.group.member_remo: someone was removed from a group
workflow.trigger_account_help: Changes of accounts from every source (administration, SCIM, sign-in providers). Only people who manage accounts may use this trigger; the workflow runs with their rights. Placeholders: {{trigger.data.username}}, {{trigger.data.display_name}}, {{trigger.data.email}}, {{trigger.data.group_name}}.
workflow.person_help: User name, alias, e-mail address or id – usually a placeholder such as {{trigger.data.username}} or {{starter.username}}.
workflow.access_help: Grants or removes permissions on a category with the rights of the chosen person: nobody gets more than that person may give. A person from the start form only when the administrator allows it (Administration → Workflow).
workflow.access_days_help: Empty: permanently. Otherwise the permission is removed automatically after this many days.
workflow.membership_help: Puts a person into a group or takes them out (needs the right to manage groups).
workflow.move_help: Moves a page to another category, e.g. into an archive (needs the right to delete in the old and to create in the new category).
workflow.admin.form_accounts: Permissions and groups from values of the start form
workflow.admin.form_accounts_help: Off (recommended): the steps Permissions and Group membership refuse a person taken from the start form of a case started by hand, because whoever starts the case chooses it. Triggers, other workflows, fixed values and {{starter.username}} always work.
workflow.file_help: Writes a document from a template into the media library – with the rights of the chosen person (upload into the category).
workflow.file_category_help: The files get the permissions of this category.
workflow.file_content_help: Text with placeholders. Lines starting with # , ## or ### become headings. Excel and CSV always contain the fields of the case as a table.
workflow.file_data: Add all fields of the case
workflow.file_data_help: Label and value of every field after the content.
workflow.file_store_help: Receives the id of the first file; the address leads to it in the media library.
workflow.calendar_help: Creates an entry in a calendar – with the rights of the chosen person (create entries in the calendar). Invitations: a following notice step with the address of the calendar.
workflow.calendar_start_help: A date (2026-12-01), date and time (2026-12-01 14:00), a placeholder such as {{field.date}} or relative: +3d, +2h, +30m.
workflow.calendar_minutes_help: Empty: 60 minutes, or one day for a date without time.
workflow.calendar_tz_help: Empty: the time zone of the server.
